title.en: Fable 3 — The Tortoise and the Hare

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.en: The hare laughed at the tortoise.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר לו: אתה איטי מאוד.
sentences.en: He said to him: you are very slow.
The tortoise said: come, let us have a race.

sentences.ar: הארנב רץ מהר והיה רחוק מאוד.
sentences.en: The hare ran fast and was far ahead.

sentences.ar: אחר כך הוא ישן מתחת לעץ.
sentences.en: Afterwards he slept under a tree.
The tortoise walked and did not stop.
The slow one who never stops arrives.
